ids: opening/status+Oct15 reconciliation;origins/progression/travel/carry/random events/life log;engine/absorption scope;paths+growth families1–22;novel-wave and concept-stage correction;life defaults/build plan/world cards/barriers/source types;many-world considerations1–8 opening
reviews.classification: selected first1080 lines of large life-sim north-star palette; original ladders/source corrections and historical runtime claims scoped
reviews.disposition:
Selected-range review only: lines1–1,080 of the7,761-line input were read in contiguous bounded outputs. The remainder1,081–7,761 stays open, including later amendments. This notice preserves findings from the opening rather than claiming a final disposition of the complete north-star palette. No linked dossier, source novel, external reference, source code or gameplay was newly read/tested by proxy.

**Authority is already layered.** The opening proposal-only header is not a veto on the later user direction quoted within this document or held by [USER_VISION](USER_VISION.md), [DIRECTION_SUMMARY](DIRECTION_SUMMARY.md) and [PROJECT](../PROJECT.md). The October15 reconciliation already supersedes mandatory vanilla-first and compulsory death-to-next-life. Keep many worlds, humble skills becoming great, varied starts and actual carry means as meaningful direction; the old vanilla default, first-ten-minutes-as-vanilla, one-realm milestone, birth-only difficulty/reload and life1→death→faster-life2 sequence do not reinstate themselves as today's universal gates. The every-wave life-feel question is an evaluative lens, not an extra check for every unrelated slice.

**Retain the range's useful causal distinctions.** Person/body/knowledge/identity, learned method versus executable faculty, actual carrier versus destination fuel, concept stage versus tier, listed/acquired/activated/observed, ordinary skill versus scarce item/seat and planner/teacher/support versus final actor all enable richer life play. A path can blend with others. A world, place, edge, individual power and actual exception can differ without one fixed override hierarchy. Data shapes and world cards help reuse but do not prove every future mechanism fits an existing primitive or require a universal engine before a selected consumer. The old generic-card-first and absorption-pass order are proposals, not current dispatch.

**Do not generalize the proposed costs.** The sample humble-skill ladders, exclusive branches, concept seats, sanity/corruption costs, forced tribulations, one-per-day examples and paid translation are illustrative. [Current skill/growth direction](SKILLS_AND_TALENTS.md) permits other conditions, free/strong carry, overlaps, different useful endpoints, powerful starts and actual exceptional means. “All paths lead to the Dao” does not require every humble skill to become one universal concept/fate system. A counter, jealous rival, hostile world, memory loss, cost or suppression needs an actual mechanism/actor rather than compensation for a strong build. Sharing a framework does not require every mechanic to appear somewhere as a new implementation obligation.

**Preserve the actual source correction.** The Skill→Origin ladder, higher concepts granting lower ones, fixed concept seats and incompatible concepts demanding stability are explicitly original proposals. The later A Novel Concept audit in this range separates stage/tier and says containment, fixed seats and seeing-as-unlocking were not established by that source. Its follow-on carry, seat-loss and tribulation suggestions do not silently become canon or global YAIR rules. Similarly, the corrected Gluttony notes explicitly distinguish its authority/perception/food mechanisms from Warlock's consume-to-gain example. The range's universal-sounding five-books carry agreement and “every strong power has a price” summarize a dated sample; they do not prove every carrier loses body/rank/fuel or every cheat needs a drawback. Exact source numbers, powers, complete-reading assertions and exclusions retain their original evidence limits until their actual qualified source owners are inspected.

**History and current behavior stay separate.** The7October module findings, no-director/no-party/no-offline/no-new-play claims,55-host/1,250-command counts, storage estimate, compacted biography sizes, installed/extracted-game table, dispatched GMs and “not owned” list are dated observations or leads. Some are explicitly corrected already within the opening. None establishes today's absence, live worker, acquisition gap or runtime behavior. The quoted historical source-path and catalog pointers are not permission to collect, redownload, spend or resume those tasks. Copyright/public-domain and public/private-pack comments are historical discussion, not a fresh legal or license determination; no content import or publication is being proposed here.

The side-log/bio front-page ideas preserve a useful life history, rumor source and ordinary interface, while today's [UI rules](UI_RULES.md) and [presentation owner](PRESENTATION_AND_FOURTH_WALL.md) govern its actual panels, text voice and observer boundaries. A narration voice aging automatically is a palette idea, not a forced player personality or permission to rewrite old observer reports. An optional map/scene remains separate from actual movement, work and consequences. Continue reading from1,081 before resolving later north-star additions. This range edit adds no new product authority, implementation, source research, test/build/browser/persistence evidence, deletion or relocation.
reviews.evidence: Actual bounded reads1–150,151–310,311–480,481–680,681–880,881–1080. Remainder1081–7761 unreviewed. No linked-body, primary-source, current runtime/license/library evidence inferred.
